name: Chess strategy
description: Plan ahead and consider the consequences of each move.
outcome: Compare possible choices using clear reasons.

name: Debate circle
description: Build an argument, listen respectfully and respond with reasons.
outcome: Work patiently and learn from a first attempt.

name: Logic-grid challenge
description: Use clues and elimination to find which statements fit together.
outcome: Share ideas and reflect on what could improve.

name: Jigsaw puzzle lab
description: Notice shapes, patterns and relationships while working toward a shared goal.
outcome: Explain the steps behind a solution.

name: Building-block engineering
description: Design a stable structure, test it and improve it after observing results.
outcome: Compare possible choices using clear reasons.

name: Mental disentanglement
description: Explore how pieces connect and practise patience while testing possible moves.
outcome: Work patiently and learn from a first attempt.

name: Pattern detectives
description: Identify repeating rules and predict what should come next.
outcome: Share ideas and reflect on what could improve.

name: Decision-making scenarios
description: Compare choices, evidence, risks and possible outcomes before deciding.
outcome: Explain the steps behind a solution.

name: Team problem-solving
description: Share roles and ideas to solve a challenge that is difficult to complete alone.
outcome: Compare possible choices using clear reasons.

name: Number riddles
description: Use number relationships and careful reasoning to explain an answer.
outcome: Work patiently and learn from a first attempt.

name: Strategy board games
description: Practise planning, adapting to changing situations and learning from outcomes.
outcome: Share ideas and reflect on what could improve.

name: Creative construction
description: Turn a design idea into a model and explain why its parts work together.
outcome: Explain the steps behind a solution.

name: Evidence and claims
description: Distinguish a claim from evidence and ask questions that test an argument.
outcome: Compare possible choices using clear reasons.

name: Visual-spatial puzzles
description: Rotate, compare and mentally combine shapes to solve a visual challenge.
outcome: Work patiently and learn from a first attempt.

name: Design a better solution
description: Define a problem, suggest several solutions, test one and reflect on improvements.
outcome: Share ideas and reflect on what could improve.
